metadata.title: Font embedding
metadata.description: Tangerine reached two ways: through the theme's heading font and through an explicit font.family on a paragraph. Download with the Embed export mode and open on a machine without Tangerine installed.

props.text: Body text stays in the theme's body font. The heading above takes Tangerine from themeOverrides.fonts.heading; the font files come from the document's fontRegistry, so they travel with the JSON.
Regular 400 set on the paragraph, **and bold 700**.
Download with the Embed export mode to write both TTF files into the .docx, then open it on a machine without Tangerine installed.
